751-6723-7060.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2113-3525-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
2113-3525-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

512-1719-7287.easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-7287.description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

4863-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4863-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
4863-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

333-5617-6495.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5617-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
333-5617-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-1981-2415-3845.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

360-1981-2415-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-1981-2415-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1011-2292-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2292-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2292-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4771-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

129-1409-4289-6791.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3480-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3480-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3480-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, Blasting Station and X-23 trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the X-23 trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
413-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

3249-6586-6798.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-6586-6798.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

2034-2308-7452.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-7452.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-4050-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4050-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

423-1437-3147-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3147-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3147-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2060-2700-2744-4499-7315.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3358-4881-7296.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6073-6972-7137.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
6073-6972-7137.description:
Kill Cytoplast Manipulator.
When Cytoplast Manipulator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Cytoplast Manipulator enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cytoplast Manipulator triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Cytoplast Manipulator dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-2292-2744-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2292-2744-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2292-2744-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1545-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

527-1978-2750.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-4053-4465.description:
Activate Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Basal Sliver dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Basal Sliver from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1495-4565-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-4565-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

2136-3525-6252.notablePrerequisites:
Boommobile is a creature.
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Orthion.
2136-3525-6252.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Boommobile with haste.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} or {R}{R}{R}{R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
2136-3525-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creature(s) using Orthion's ability or activate a Boommobile's ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

413-586-944-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

2167-3678-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-3678-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1621-3719-5912.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
1621-3719-5912.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Wispweaver Angel and create at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
1621-3719-5912.notes: If you have four or more experience counters, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1441-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Bill the Pony.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Foods.

1863-3946-5449.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3750-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Rith.
There are at least eight permanents of any particular color on the battlefield.
3750-3973-4050.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith ability, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
If there are at least nine permanents of any particular color on the battlefield, this combo will net infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

826-2415-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2415-4508.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's first ability by tapping it, causing Havoc Jester to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1170-4331-5034.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Urza.
Urza enters the battlefield, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Urza's second ability by tapping the Construct, adding {U}.
Sol Ring resolves.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1817-2649.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
1817-2649.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, targeting any non-Human creature.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, targeting the Vadrok spell.
Resolve Double Major, copying the Vadrok spell, targeting the non-Human creature.
Resolve the copy of the Vadrok spell, putting it under the non-Human creature.
Vadrok triggers, casting Double Major from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the Vadrok spell.
Repeat from step 3.
With each iteration, you will gain an additional Vadrok trigger, which you can use to cast any other noncreature spells with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard,

2104-2493-3395.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
